nodes.label: v0.4 Plan
nodes.rationale: Two scaling bottlenecks (2200-char memory cap, no session history search) motivate hybrid core+extended SQLite architecture

nodes.label: Session History Search (FTS5)
nodes.rationale: Agent-driven, not automatic, to avoid injecting irrelevant context into every session

nodes.label: Extended Memory Store (SQLite, unlimited)
nodes.rationale: Core memory capped at 5000 chars stays always-injected; unlimited overflow lives in SQLite and is searched on demand
